method: page-side performance.now() at the dispatched input event to the second requestAnimationFrame after it; Playwright performs the input; show_impact waits for the dependents list

node_hover.node_targeting: sigma node event raised from the page after the real mouse input (no GPU picking)

node_click.node_targeting: sigma node event raised from the page after the real mouse input (no GPU picking)

show_impact.node_targeting: sigma node event raised from the page after the real mouse input (no GPU picking)

note: Headless run: Chromium used software GL (SwiftShader), so these numbers are NOT product evidence; node hover, click and impact events were raised from the page after the real mouse input because software GL never resolves a node under the pointer (see node_targeting); re-measure headed on operator hardware (PRP-66). The 200 ms p95 figure is reported for this hardware and 2000 nodes only; no claim is made about 50k nodes.
